title: Flagged for Review — irregularities and unverified items (none block publication)

rows.title: No official market price source exists
rows.detail: Every market open/close, market line and difference cell in this project is blank because the NFL publishes no betting lines. Blanks are policy, not omissions.

rows.title: All staking numbers use an ASSUMED -110 price
rows.detail: Straight-up side picks are not obtainable at -110 in real markets (favorites carry heavier juice). Staking ROI figures are mechanical applications of the declared assumption and must not be read as achievable returns. Points are held at 0 by amendment A1 until prices are verified.

rows.title: 105 of 137 feed rows are aggregate-verified only
rows.detail: Weeks 2-8 games were not re-read page-by-page this session; their correctness rests on 160/160 aggregate matches plus a 32-game line-by-line sample. Proposed full re-read: SG-02.

rows.title: Dates for weeks 2-8 are peer-transcribed
rows.detail: CR-04 (rest) uses feed dates; only weeks 1, 9, 10 dates were re-read this session.

rows.title: Player-prop strategy S5 permanently blocked
rows.detail: No official player-prop prices exist; S5 cannot be validated, settled or scored. Blank cells everywhere props would appear.

rows.title: Injury capture is 2 of 8 official-report chunks
rows.detail: 107 player rows across WAS/NYG/NE/DET/KC/ATL/MIN/GB/JAX captured this session; 6 chunks and the rest of the JAX game were not read. Teams not captured are simply absent, not guessed.

rows.title: No official depth chart
rows.detail: nfl.com depth-chart routes do not resolve; 2nd/3rd/4th-string depth is published only where official prose states it (RD-01). All other depth cells blank.

rows.title: Week 10 scores page hides some finals
rows.detail: The WAS-NYG final rendered as 'Hidden Score' on the scores page; the score was read from the official game page instead (24-21).

rows.title: Open and close snapshots taken in the same session
rows.detail: Open = model trained through Week 9; close = trained through Week 10 TNF (one extra game). Drift is small (e.g., IND@HOU side -8.0 -> -7.9). A true pre-kickoff close requires a re-run before 2026-11-19 (SG-11).

rows.title: Gate thresholds are project policy, not official rules
rows.detail: G1-G8 and D1 thresholds (n>=100, CI rules, placebo p<0.05) are design choices declared in gates.json.

rows.title: Model has no quarterback, injury or depth features
rows.detail: Origination uses only official score-derived ratings; confirmed QB changes (e.g., MIA, SEA) cannot move the line (Q06/Q07).

rows.title: Fitted HFA (+0.15 pts) is far below the historical norm
rows.detail: 137-game sample; could be genuine for 2026 so far or estimation noise (Q11).

rows.title: S2 total model underperforms the constant-mean baseline
rows.detail: Total MAE 21.6 (model) vs 11.1 (train mean) in walk-forward — early-week small samples and noisy off/def sums. Published as-is; S2 fails its gates.

rows.title: Post-hoc baseline comparison not pre-registered
rows.detail: Model 0.673 vs better-record 0.635 is a post-hoc diagnostic (amendment A2); the pre-registered G2 baseline remains 0.500.

rows.title: Parallel session PR #93 touches shared files
rows.detail: Open PR #93 (nfl-command-center) also edits COORDINATION.md and index.html; conflicts will be resolved union-style at integration, no work discarded.

rows.title: Placebo p reported as 0/500 draws
rows.detail: S1's placebo p is '<0.002' (0 of 500 placebos reached its ROI), displayed as such rather than as an exact zero probability.

rows.title: CR-04 p-values use a normal approximation of the t test
rows.detail: Disclosed in correlations.json method; exact t-distribution p-values are not computed (stdlib only).
